input.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice windows to 60 days in Base Agreement § 4.0 and Statement of Work § 2.0.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that an auto-renewing term must be exitable on no more than 60 days' notice; six months (Base Agreement) and twelve months (Attachment 1) are far outside that, and the twelve-month window is longer than the six-month renewal period it governs. We have simply shortened both notice windows to sixty (60) days and left the renewal periods and all other terms unchanged.

ops.oldText: unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice
ops.newText: unless either Party gives sixty (60) days written notice

ops.oldText: unless either party gives twelve (12) months written notice
ops.newText: unless either party gives sixty (60) days written notice
